contracts: No action when helper opens; explicit per-step execution; Practice backstop before every worker action.
Keys generated only inside exclusively created new folder; local create_dir and UNIX0700, remote mkdir without-p; never overwrite/reuse folders or delete key material.
Passphrases go through installed OpenSSH in existing PTY, never app fields/argv/settings/activity; no app private-key reads.
Local upload accepts typed validated public fields only; bounded input, SSH wire checks, no comments/private headers/extra lines.
GitHub account check and eventual one-use upload share exact captured token environment; Gitea API captures its checked login. No global account switch.
SSH/WSL setup uses own machine tools/logins; local credentials/paths not copied. SSH transport-a disables local-agent forwarding.
Remote public upload is reduced/validated before CLI; tea gets only owned temporary public data and explicit login/account confirmation.
All account/file reservation work runs in connections::spawn with captured Context and private active/receiver ownership. Close/profile changes discard late results.
Repository keyboard capture and queued file actions refuse while setup is open; helper keeps parked worktrees unfinished until closed.
No new process controller, host PID selector/watchdog/signals or remote session APIs; existing owned Terminal and bounded_process only.
fixture_scope: Pure command/path/format assertions cover POSIX/native-Windows/SSH/WSL routing.
New executable fixtures use env_clear, isolated HOME/TMPDIR, owned recording fake ssh-keygen/ssh-add/ssh/gh/tea only; no user keys/accounts or actual remote transport.
Local GH fixtures verify exact-token pinning across simulated login/profile changes, cancellation and diagnostic redaction.
Owned loopback HTTP fixtures verify Forgejo/Gitea POST /api/v1/user/keys with dummy token and public-only payload.
Actual egui rendering proves setup has no startup side effects and terminal prompt remains visible in supported800x500 viewport.
limits: Existing OpenSSH tools and an already available agent are required; helper does not launch daemon/change global SSH configuration.
Remote Forgejo/Gitea upload requires tea0.16+; command syntax inspected from official Go module source, not an actual remote service.

Direct SSH test deliberately ignores additive identities/agent keys and SSH aliases/proxies; enter actual destination/port and read forge greeting because exit1 may indicate authenticated no-shell account.
Closing cannot undo an already submitted remote/API mutation; new key folders/files are retained.
Native Windows and live SSH/WSL/forge accounts were not exercised. CI remains deferred by explicit user policy.
Independent exact-candidate review and final combined source/tests are still required before the one final PR.
Native Windows cases were added but not executed on Linux; exact Windows fallback function was exercised with explicit platform=true pure fixtures. No CI was used.

correction.finding: P2: reject malformed reserved WSL UNC shares before native Windows local fallback
correction.behavior: Successful remote parsing remains authoritative. If parsing fails, native Windows reserved wsl.localhost/wsl$ UNC authorities, including case/separator/extended forms, are rejected before local fallback. Whole server components are matched; ordinary UNC/local paths and non-Windows share semantics are preserved.
correction.native_test_containment: Valid UNC parsing is pure. Failed-open UI fixture constructs the existing watcher on an owned local directory, then replaces only the model path; no UNC filesystem lookup or WSL process is needed.
